description: Mark a message as read or unread. Reversible: call again with the opposite `read` value.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without touching the message.

expectMessageId.description: Optional RFC Message-ID the id must still name: a row's messageIdHeader (request it with fields). On mismatch nothing happens and the error code is message_identity_mismatch.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

messageId.description: Compound message ID from mail_list output.

read.description: true marks the message read; false marks it unread.
